title: [nightly/design] Saved scan: "Scan another", and the round at a glance
summary: After a card saves, the screen confirms the course, day, tee, score and a hole-by-hole strip, and adds Scan another so a stack of cards can be entered in a row. A round that saved but won't load back no longer sits on "Loading…".
